description: This file defines the TenantTracingConfig class which manages tenant-specific tracing configuration, including sampling modes for tracing spans in the context of a multi-tenant system.

classes.name: TenantTracingConfig
classes.description: A class that encapsulates tenant-specific tracing configuration options, including modes and per-auth ID configurations.

methods.name: getSamplingMode
methods.description: Returns the default tracing sampling mode for the tenant.

methods.name: setSamplingMode
methods.description: Sets the default tracing sampling mode for the tenant.

methods.name: getSamplingModePerAuthId
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of authentication IDs to their specific sampling modes.

methods.name: setSamplingModePerAuthId
methods.description: Sets the per-auth ID sampling modes, replacing existing configurations.

methods.name: getSamplingMode
methods.description: Returns the sampling mode for a specific authentication ID, or the default if not set.
